title: Happy Dance
description: Tuareg nomads end the Ramadan fast with prayer and dancing in Timbuktu, Mali. The Tuaregs are a subset of the Berbers, an Indigenous ethnic group in North Africa, and have resided across the Sahara desert in Niger, Mali, Libya, Algeria, and Burkina Faso. They primarily practice Islam and, as National Geographic reported in a 2011 feature, the ethnic group is distinguished primarily by its common language, Tamashek, which is related to Berber tongues spoken in Algeria and Morocco.
translated_description: 在马里廷巴克图，图阿雷格游牧民族以祈祷和舞蹈结束斋月。图阿雷格人是柏柏尔人的一支，柏柏尔人是北非的原住民族群，他们世代居住在尼日尔、马里、利比亚、阿尔及利亚和布基纳法索的撒哈拉沙漠地区。图阿雷格人主要信奉伊斯兰教。据《国家地理》2011年的一篇专题报道所述，该民族最显著的特征是其共同语言——塔马谢克语，这种语言与阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥使用的柏柏尔语方言存在关联。
